  Under the hood
  
Sixteen scenes. One small toolkit.

  
01
Living light
A WebGL fragment shader. Layered noise warps itself and your finger sends a ripple through it. Pauses offscreen.
~2 KB · no lib

  
02
Five pillars
Five pillars across a year: work, personal, health, family, all of it. The avatar is lit by the scene, kicks up dust, splashes, sprays snow and leaves trails when you scroll fast.
Canvas · sprites

  
03
Portrait in depth
A cutout that pops out of an arch, colors in as you scroll, tilts in 3D and wears its credentials as floating tags.
CSS 3D + GSAP

  
+
Yeshu, the guide
Your avatar in miniature. He walks when you scroll, faces the way you go, hops across the screen with squash and stretch, and narrates each section.
sprites + GSAP

  
+
Professional work
Panels that widen on hover, or follow your scroll on a phone, to give one practice the stage at a time.
flex-grow · CSS

  
+
Shipping in public
A git branch drawn by scroll, with a node landing on each repository as it slides in.
SVG + scrub

  
04
Particle words
Words drawn offscreen, sampled into points, and sprung between as you scroll. Touch pushes them away.
Canvas · no lib

  
05
Baton loop
A typed terminal timeline with a live signal between human and agent. Replayable.
~1 KB · no lib

  
06
Studio stack
Sticky cards that sink back as the next slides over. Products without screenshots get generative art.
sticky + scrub

  
07
The 202-mile line
A path drawn by scroll with a rider, an odometer and the real clock from the ride journal.
SVG + ScrollTrigger

  
08
Sideways miles
Vertical scroll drives a horizontal track; numbers fill and photos unmask as each panel lands.
containerAnimation

  
09
Career timeline
A line that draws itself while the year rolls from 2016 to now.
scrub + sticky

  
10
Toolbox in motion
Bands of type that speed up and reverse with your scroll.
rAF · no lib

  
11
Field notes
A photo that trails the cursor and tilts with its speed. Thumbnails on touch screens.
rAF · no lib

  
12
The opening
A living blob, a magnetic button, and a circular wipe from exactly where you pressed.
clip-path · GSAP

  
Libraries: GSAP 3.13 core + ScrollTrigger (about 70 KB gzipped). Everything else is hand-written.Reduced-motion settings get a calm, fully readable page. See the previous version.
